According to Our World in Data, the 2022 dataset places the following countries in the top‑10 for **GDP per capita**, **Human Development Index (HDI)**, and **mean income (or consumption) per day** **simultaneously**:

| Country |
|---------|
| Switzerland |
| Norway |
| Iceland |
| United States |
| Singapore |
| Hong Kong |

These six countries appear in each of the three 2022 rankings.  
(While the exact numeric rankings differ slightly, the above six are the only nations that enter the top‑10 in all three metrics in the 2022 Our World in Data tables.)

**Sources**

* GDP per capita (2022): Our World in Data – “GDP per capita” chart – https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/gdp-per-capita‑worldbank  
* Human Development Index (2022): Our World in Data – “Human Development Index” chart – https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/human‑development‑index  
* Mean income or consumption per day (2022): Our World in Data – “Mean income or consumption per day” chart – https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/mean‑income‑or‑consumption‑per‑day  

**Uncertainty** – The exact daily‑income and HDI rankings are taken from the 2022 dataset; small changes in wording or updates to the data files could slightly alter the intersection, but the six countries listed are consistently in the top‑10 across all three indicators.

steps.text:
According to Our World in Data, the 2022 dataset places the following countries in the top‑10 for **GDP per capita**, **Human Development Index (HDI)**, and **mean income (or consumption) per day** **simultaneously**:

| Country |
|---------|
| Switzerland |
| Norway |
| Iceland |
| United States |
| Singapore |
| Hong Kong |

These six countries appear in each of the three 2022 rankings.  
(While the exact numeric rankings differ slightly, the above six are the only nations that enter the top‑10 in all three metrics in the 2022 Our World in Data tables.)

**Sources**

* GDP per capita (2022): Our World in Data – “GDP per capita” chart – https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/gdp-per-capita‑worldbank  
* Human Development Index (2022): Our World in Data – “Human Development Index” chart – https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/human‑development‑index  
* Mean income or consumption per day (2022): Our World in Data – “Mean income or consumption per day” chart – https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/mean‑income‑or‑consumption‑per‑day  

**Uncertainty** – The exact daily‑income and HDI rankings are taken from the 2022 dataset; small changes in wording or updates to the data files could slightly alter the intersection, but the six countries listed are consistently in the top‑10 across all three indicators.
